simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲרוּ (H718) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: inj.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲרוּ (ʼărûw) means lo! First listed occurrence: Dan 7 2.

definitions.full: H718. aru אֲרוּ interjection lo (of uncertain derivation: only Biblical Aramaic (? Nabataean, see CIS ii. 186 ); אֲלוּ , and Late Hebrew הֲרֵי see! Here! Ab Dan 3:4 and elsewhere, are perhaps allied), וַאֲרוּ 7:2 וַאֲרוּ ֗֗֗ הֲוֵית חָוֵי , 7:5 ; 7:6 ; 7:7 ; 7:13 , always in description of a vision (compare אֲלוּ ).
